channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Racial Disparities Linked to Food Allergy Resolution
item.description: Race and parental health literacy influence whether children outgrow food allergies, with historically marginalized groups showing lower rates.

item.title: FDA Approves Blood Test for Alzheimer's Evaluation
item.description: The FDA has cleared a blood test for marketing, developed from technology invented at Washington University.

item.title: Common ASM Linked to Higher Thromboembolic Risk with DOACs
item.description: Levetiracetam is associated with increased thromboembolic risk in epilepsy patients on DOACs, though experts urge caution in interpretation.

item.title: Late Diagnosis and Limited Care Drive Gynecologic Cancer Deaths in LMICs
item.description: Low- and middle-income countries face a higher burden of gynecologic cancers due to late diagnosis and inadequate healthcare access.
